inputBindings.initialParameterCorrection: Three initialization INSERT parameter groups are not three Jsonb objects. In the frozen run sourceSeq22/23 have present=false and image=null; sourceSeq24 has present=true and the sole explicit Jsonb legacy image. Verify these raw facts rather than a mistaken count.

supportedRange.business: Pinned FastAPI Users SQLAlchemy get/create/update/delete over one controlled existing native six-column user table plus private UUID version metadata.
supportedRange.keys: Explicit fixed canonical UUID domain of 1..128 keys. Missing/absent state is represented by a witnessed tombstone token and false presence, never an invented version.
supportedRange.sql: Exact fixed business SQL/parameter/result mappings already checked by the old strict batch verifier; new exact control-query/DDL templates are separately compiled and reviewed.
supportedRange.unsupported: Arbitrary SQL, unknown keys, alternate ORM schemas, partial business fetches, zero DML without full source, unsupported values, server errors, unknown commit outcomes and unobserved side effects retain gaps.
assumptions: Controlled writers within the fixed domain
No unobserved DDL, trigger disablement or owned metadata mutation during capture
Pinned standard driver adapters with no custom connection/global dumper overrides
supportedRange.authenticity: Checks the semantic/structural consistency and provenance bindings of supplied observations. It does not authenticate the collector or prove that no external actor lied.

journal.sequence: Positive contiguous sourceSeq, unique initialization, all original control/source-gap/business records, one final ledger, exactly one final original-byte prefix seal.
journal.position: Initial metadata remains in the installation record after its initialization COMMIT. Final catalog/functions/marker/snapshot/ledger observations remain only in the terminal final-effect-ledger record after finalization COMMIT. Do not backfill final facts into initial metadata.
journal.businessBindings: Original statement and delivered rows event seq remain unchanged; internal presenceRows/effectRows and actual server PGresult are not relabelled as business rows or reads.

controlProof.query: Every retained control-query uses a recognized exact SQL template and exact parameters. Every referenced querySeq points to a prior actual record with the expected SQL, parameters, result, physical connection/backendPid and transaction.
controlProof.nativeRaw: Check status, commandTag bytes/text, commandTuples, rowcount, ntuples/nfields, column names/typeCode and every native/raw cell. All supported PGresult fields have text format 0. Decode raw cells independently according to the fixed OID, not by trusting a Python checked flag.
controlProof.arrays: Only the actual flat bool/name/smallint/text arrays required by fixed catalog queries. Quoting, escapes and nulls must decode correctly; unsupported nested/ambiguous encodings cannot be silently accepted.
controlProof.jsonb: The typed parameter is accepted only as explicit owned-setup {captureType:'psycopg-jsonb',objectDumps:'stdlib-json-dumps',value:pureJSON}. Compare its actual value against the corresponding raw server state/image, not merely its label.
controlProof.ddl: Validate all 13 fixed installation DDL statements, source bodies and acknowledgements within the business lock transaction. Unknown additional DDL/control SQL is a provenance gap, not a proof exemption.
controlProof.preMigration: Check the actual pre-migration business catalog and side-effect observations before allowing migration statements to justify source facts. Do not rely only on the post-migration catalog.

windowProof.initial: Actual BEGIN ACK, first business-only ACCESS EXCLUSIVE lock before ALTER/other migration statements, later business+all four owned-table lock, actual catalog/function/marker queries, seven-cell joined snapshot and actual COMMIT ACK. All are ordered within one physical connection/backendPid/client transaction, with matching transaction statuses.
windowProof.final: A separate real transaction locks business+all owned tables, re-observes catalog/functions/marker, reads snapshot and full ledger, then receives actual COMMIT ACK. Every leaf is bound to that transaction's control queries.
windowProof.failedAck: A requested COMMIT, Python success flag, incomplete result or source-gap never substitutes for the corresponding server acknowledgement.
windowProof.sevenCellSnapshot: Check [key,token,present,stateImage,businessId,businessToken,businessImage] against actual same-statement joined result, initial/terminal state and trace snapshot. For an absent row stateImage is null while businessImage is the actual six-null-fields jsonb_build_object result; do not change it to SQL null.
windowProof.catalog: Both business and four owned catalogs are checked against fixed supported schema/constraints/indexes/trigger sets and zero forbidden side-effect counts. Function raw source/catalog/OID and trigger source/type/enablement/arguments are checked at both boundaries against fixed templates.
windowProof.equality: Verify the permitted initial/final metadata invariants and final state/ledger chains without treating matching boundaries as proof of no intervening unobserved DDL.

effectAndSourceProof.reuse: Reuse the old strict original SQL/parameters/executedSQL, typed native/raw business PGresult, business row prefix/EOF and same-statement presence/effect verification.
effectAndSourceProof.ledger: Every committed unreverted observed effect, including overwritten intermediate writes, is in the actual terminal ledger; aborted/reverted effects are excluded there but retained in original observations. Compare the full images, presence transitions, key, token and predecessor.
effectAndSourceProof.predecessor: Metadata predecessor is a source-chain fact and never becomes a synthetic business read.
effectAndSourceProof.partialEvidence: May emit individually proven statements/facts with exact control/source event references even if another part of the trace remains incomplete. Never report the whole trace ready merely because local source proofs passed.

output.gaps: Preserve the original lifecycle/unsupported/zero/error/source gaps and a draft-only no-exemption marker. Add precise raw-control/catalog/window/source issues. Do not clear original gaps by trusting Python audit checked:true.
output.failure: Any invalid original lifecycle, duplicate keys, malformed seal, unsafe raw binding or unsupported control evidence cannot retain a complete source-profile proof. No fabricated history is returned.

acceptancePlan.baseline: Bind original source/trace bytes from the frozen actual run. No new database execution is needed for this checker.
mutations: Changed setup Jsonb payload or unsupported dumps label
Initial/final function source or catalog mismatch
acceptancePlan.memory: Build the isolated workspace with one compiler job and coordinate with the parent full regression. Do not overwrite root src/scripts/dist or old draft binaries.
acceptancePlan.independence: Ask the separate reviewer to check mutations and raw data bindings. Same-agent producer audit flags are not inputs to acceptance.
